author: Inside Edition
description: Inside Edition teamed up with Milestone Pharmaceuticals and its ambassador, board-certified cardiologist Dr. Stephanie Saucier, to learn more about a treatment option for people with a heart condition known as PSVT. Dr. Saucier says patients now have a convenient way to treat the condition, which causes unexpected rapid heart rates. Listen in as she discusses the first FDA-approved, self-administered prescription nasal spray designed to help stop a PSVT episode. Learn More at cardamyst.com
title: FDA Approved Option Designed To Treat Heart Condition Known As PSVT

author: Inside Edition
description: Cops in Wisconsin say they're investigating a possible hazing incident. Madison Police say an anonymous tip led them to a basement where they say about 30 men were coated in food, condiments and other liquids. They say the heat in the basement was set to 81 degrees and some of the men had physical injuries. Investigators say the event was being held by Alpha Epsilon Pi fraternity at an off-campus location near the University of Wisconsin Madison. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: In Alleged Frat Hazing, Cops Finds 30 Pledges Covered in Food in Hot Basement

author: Inside Edition
description: Millions of people along the East Coast are preparing for a severe storm known as a nor'easter.  High winds, heavy rain and flooding are expected from the Carolinas to Maine. But before you start clearing fallen branches and downed trees, be careful that you don't end up like a man who fell off his ladder and was severely injured when a tree branch went right through his face. Inside Edition's Justin Finch reports.
title: Man Falls Off Ladder And Gets Impaled In Face By Tree Branch
